title: Product landing pages for ad campaigns: Auritus, Chatticus, Papyrus
description: Before an ad can point at a product, each needs one page with the promise, proof, and a call to action. Auritus: live product, link to aurit.us and the GitHub repo; proof is the example pages playing six TTS backends. Chatticus: pre-launch, chattic.us already has a waitlist; anth.us copy must say early access, never live or in use by customers. Papyrus: no public product site found; the anth.us engage card is the only surface, and the proof is the public ANTH newsroom board. Decide per product whether the landing page lives on anth.us or the product domain, then write it. Depends on the platform pages task.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-13 audit after the arcade launch: Anth.us now prominently links Cyclotron, Chatticus, Papyrus and Primus. Immediate acquisition gap: p.apyr.us presents a waitlist but explicitly says submissions are not connected. Cyclotron pricing and services enquiries lead to the generic Google form; Primus remains an AI Agent Incubator with Request Early Access. Align each product destination with a working next step and actual availability before campaigns. Preserve product/plan/campaign intent and measure successful booking, signup, activation and paid retention. Do not implement until Ryan chooses the offer/funnel direction.

right_now_summary: Ryan must choose each product’s offer and funnel before landing pages are written.
